ns2:course.label: Technology and Costume Crafts
ns2:course.description: This is a mixed-level course for students who are exploring costume technology in depth. Modern technologies such as 3D printing, use of programmable LED lights, fiber optics, laser cutting, and other innovations are the new resources available to create cutting-edge costumes. During the course students will learn the theory and foundations of these technologies and their practical implementation. 4 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: Theatre majors only.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: 4 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: Theatre majors only.
ns2:course.sectionDeptRestriction: Restricted to students in the Theatre department.
